messages:
alex: quick heads-up — after yesterday's token_budget tweak (target=120) we saw a mid-afternoon spike on the 8xA100 pool. latency p50 -> p95 widened for 512-1024 seqs
lia: saw it in the dashboard too, p50 steady but p95 doubled around 14:10 UTC, error rates unchanged
ben: my short profiler run points at frequent kernel swaps to FlashAttention on medium-length requests, plus a rise in paged-KV page faults. attaching brief snip below
ben: ```
# perf-summary (sample)
FlashAttentionKernel::forward       48.2%   13.1ms
HybridKernel::forward              27.9%    7.5ms
PagedKV::page_fault                14.0%    3.8ms
Batcher::form_batch_overhead       10.0%    2.7ms
```
sara: that's interesting — token_budget=120 reduced batching window, so more small-ish batches hit the flash path?
alex: exactly. the lower token_budget forced earlier flushes; we've tuned kernel selector to prefer FlashAttention at seq >= 64 when batch_size >= 8. but with smaller windows we often have seq ~80 but batch=4 -> selector oscillates
lia: oscillation why: because selection heuristics look at avg_seq and batch_size; rapid queue changes flip the comparator. we saw kernel churn in traces
perf-bot: uploaded profile gist: https://profiles.internal/runs/2109001234/trace.html :thumbsup:
ben: from the trace: when kernel swaps happen mid-token the KV residency goes from 95% to 70% and we incur paged-KV evictions on the bigger model shards
sara: eviction -> rehydrate -> stalls. p95 spikes line up with KV rehydrate events in the trace
alex: proposed mitigations:
- add hysteresis on kernel selection (require sustained condition for 150ms before swap)
- increase min_batch_size for FlashAttention preference from 8 -> 12
- raise token_budget back to 160 for experiment window
- add a prefault step on KV hotset when we detect a kernel swap
lia: also suggest metric: kernel_swap_rate per minute + kv_eviction_rate as an alert pairing. current alerts only watch paging errors, not swap churn
ben: quick A/B plan: run canary with hysteresis + min_batch_size bump on one lane of A100s and keep others as baseline. collect p50/p95 + kv_eviction. can do 1hr run this evening
sara: ack. I'll spin up the canary config:```json
{"continuous_batcher": {"token_budget": 120, "min_batch_size": 12, "kernel_hysteresis_ms": 150}}
```
alex: thanks. if canary shows reduced p95 and lower paged-KV faults we can roll to all dedicated pools. if not, next step is prefaulting strategy (costly)
lia: one more note — FlashAttention gives better throughput but is sensitive to memory layout; some of the medium-seq requests came from a multi-turn chat test that has sparse KV locality. may be worth adding a KV residency predictor to selector logic
ben: agreed. for immediate follow-up I'll attach the profiler flame and a diff of the selector logic (small heuristic change) to the canary PR
perf-bot: canary scheduled for 21:30 UTC on lane-a100-4, duration 60m
alex: perfect. thanks all — will monitor console and loop back with metrics in ~90m
lia: please ping here if p95 increases or if any errors crop up :eyes:
